other_failure_modes.name: Naive Target Encoding (In-Sample Leakage)
other_failure_modes.description: Target encoding is computed directly on the training set without out-of-fold processing, cross-validation, or smoothing. This causes the target variable to leak directly into the training features, leading to severe model overfitting (especially for rare categories).

summary: The agent constructs an extensive feature engineering pipeline while correctly avoiding global leakage by splitting the data first. However, the solution suffers from severe in-sample target leakage due to naive target encoding computed directly on the training set. Additionally, the agent relies entirely on the model to handle missing values and does not account for variance by evaluating the stochastic model over multiple runs.
